name: Domes Zeen Chania
positioning: Domes Zeen Chania, a Luxury Collection Resort, Crete: a beachfront resort with a private beach on Crete's rugged coastline, close to Chania, with an outdoor spa and a Kids Club
best_for: Families who want a Kids Club, a children's pool and a private beach
Travelers who want guided Cretan experiences such as Samaria Gorge hikes, Chania old town tours and ceramic workshops
Guests who want an outdoor spa with ancient rituals

facts.text: Domes Zeen Chania is a resort on Crete's rugged coastline, close to Chania.
Spa services include couples massages and in-suite massages.
The Gym Pavilion has cardiovascular equipment, free weights, strength equipment and Reformer Pilates beds.
The resort has an outdoor main swimming pool and an outdoor children's pool.
KiEpos is an eco-conscious concept for young guests, who plant and learn about vegetables, insects and flowers under expert guidance.
The resort offers guided walking tours of Chania's old town.
Experiences include wine and olive oil tasting sessions.
ENINO is the resort's wine-themed degustation restaurant, where private wine tastings with tapas-style Greek mezedes pairings are held.
Experiences include visits to organic Cretan beauty brands.

highlights.text: The resort is beachfront, with a private beach offering complimentary loungers and umbrellas.
The signature Soma Spa is outdoors and offers a variety of ancient rituals.
The resort offers hiking tours through Samaria Gorge.
The Kids Club is supervised by Montessori-inspired, qualified staff.
Experiences include ceramic workshops guided by ceramics professionals.

considerations.text: The resort is set up for families, with a Kids Club and a children's pool, so expect children around.
Chania's old town and Samaria Gorge are off-site; the resort offers them as guided tours.
